title: Capital Markets Senior Analyst
description:
The Senior Analyst will be responsible for providing analytical support for the Company’s financing strategy and capital markets activities, including assessment of financing alternatives, preparation of financing/underwriting materials, and transaction execution. This person will also assist in managing the Company’s existing debt instruments, including debt covenant compliance and reporting and utilization of facility commitments, and executing the hedging program.

Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities

- Provide analytical support for all financing-related activities, including Excel modeling, report generation, and coordination with  Asset Management, Operations, Finance and Accounting teams to review and analyze asset-level and corporate financial results and operating performance metrics, and communicate to the various lending partners.

- Build underwriting and financial models to support requirements associated with debt financing structures, including internal analysis of key metrics/terms, the impact of covenants, and deliverables to third parties.

- Work with senior members of the Capital Markets team to ensure compliance with obligations in financing agreements, including delivery of required financial reporting and covenant compliance documentation.

- Prepare and maintain debt-related documentation, including offering memoranda, term sheets, and financial reports.

- Manage monthly funding requests under financing agreements, including associated documentation requirements.

- Track macroeconomic and market-specific performance indicators that could impact consideration of financing alternatives.

- Collect, synthesize, and model data to support analysis of strategic initiatives, capital allocation, and asset management decisions.

- Assist in the preparation of presentation materials for the Company’s Senior Management Team, Board of Directors, current and/or potential investors/ lenders.

- Interact with key internal and external partners, including financial institutions, sponsors, loan servicers, legal counsel, and others.

- Assist with FX and interest rate risk management, including hedging strategies, program execution, and monthly settlements.

Education and/or Experience

- Bachelor’s Degree and strong academic record.

- Minimum 5 years of experience required; financial modeling and/or real estate focus preferred.

- Investment banking, corporate banking, private equity, finance, and/or accounting experience preferred.

- Familiarity with various real estate and infrastructure debt financing structures, including securitizations, is a plus.

Skills/Specialized Knowledge

- High degree of proficiency with Excel required, including comfort and familiarity with advanced Excel functions.

- Proficiency with all Microsoft Office applications, including Word and PowerPoint, required.

- Well-developed analytical abilities, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.

- High degree of intellectual curiosity.

- Excellent organizational skills; ability to manage multiple competing priorities and deadlines.

- Well-developed written and verbal communication skills.

- Outstanding interpersonal skills with a team-oriented mentality and ability to maintain confidentiality.

- Self-starter with a strong sense of ownership.

- Comfort and familiarity with basic finance and accounting theory, including reading and comprehending financial statements.

- Strong work ethic and commitment to operational excellence with the ability to succeed and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

- Adaptable to a changing work environment and shifting priorities.

- Ability to effectively engage employees and build relationships across the company at all levels.

title: Energy Policy & Regulatory Affairs Manager
description:
CyrusOne is seeking a talented and highly motivated energy policy professional to support the company's energy policy, regulatory, and advocacy efforts across North America. The Energy Policy & Regulatory Affairs Manager will play a key role in monitoring policy and regulatory developments, conducting research and analysis, supporting advocacy initiatives, and helping advance CyrusOne's positions on energy, infrastructure, and utility-related matters.
Reporting to the Director, Energy Policy & Regulatory Affairs, this position will work closely with internal business partners and external stakeholders to identify opportunities and risks arising from legislative, regulatory, market, and policy developments. The successful candidate will possess a strong understanding of the energy industry, including utility regulation, energy infrastructure, wholesale and retail energy markets, renewable energy development, and public policy issues affecting data center growth and operations.

Responsibilities:

Policy Analysis & Regulatory Monitoring

- Monitor federal, state, provincial, regional, and local legislative, regulatory, and policy developments impacting CyrusOne's business interests.

- Research and analyze energy, utility, market, infrastructure, and regulatory issues affecting data center development and operations.

- Track utility commission proceedings, legislative initiatives, market reform efforts, and regulatory proceedings relevant to the company's growth strategy.

- Summarize complex policy and regulatory developments and communicate implications to internal stakeholders.

- Maintain awareness of emerging trends related to energy infrastructure, grid reliability, transmission development, renewable energy, and sustainability initiatives.

Advocacy Support

- Support the development and execution of advocacy initiatives that advance CyrusOne's energy and infrastructure priorities.

- Assist in preparing policy position papers, briefing materials, presentations, comments, testimony, talking points, and stakeholder communications.

- Coordinate internal review and approval processes for policy-related materials.

- Support engagement with industry associations, coalition partners, consultants, and other external stakeholders.

- Assist in preparing for meetings with policymakers, regulators, utilities, and industry organizations.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build and maintain effective working relationships with internal business partners and external stakeholders.

- Participate in industry meetings, conferences, regulatory workshops, and stakeholder forums.

- Coordinate information gathering from subject matter experts, consultants, and stakeholders to support policy positions and business objectives.

- Collaborate with Land Strategy, Power & Energy, Market Intelligence, Development, Legal, Sustainability, and other teams to understand policy impacts on business initiatives.

Business Support & Strategic Analysis

- Provide policy and regulatory research support to business leaders and project teams.

- Assist in evaluating regulatory risks and opportunities associated with development projects, utility initiatives, and energy procurement activities.

- Support development of strategic recommendations related to regulatory and policy matters.

- Contribute to internal planning efforts by providing analysis of energy market and policy trends.

- Develop reports, presentations, and analytical materials to support executive decision-making.

Additional Responsibilities

- Maintain organized records of policy developments, regulatory activities, stakeholder engagement efforts, and advocacy initiatives.

- Support special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned.

- Perform other duties as required.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Law, Energy Management, Economics, Environmental Policy, Business, or a related field.

- 7+ years of experience in energy policy, regulatory affairs, government affairs, public affairs, utility regulation, energy markets, or a related field.

- Experience working for or with utilities, regulators, governmental agencies, energy companies, trade associations, consulting firms, or related organizations.

- Working knowledge of energy markets, utility regulation, energy infrastructure, renewable energy policy, and regulatory processes.

- Experience monitoring and analyzing legislative, regulatory, and policy developments.

- Strong research, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

- Ability to communicate complex policy and regulatory topics to a variety of audiences.

- Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.

- Ability to travel as business needs require.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Experience supporting regulatory proceedings, legislative initiatives, or energy policy advocacy efforts.

- Knowledge of wholesale energy markets, transmission policy, electric utility regulation, renewable energy policy, or energy procurement programs.

- Familiarity with issues affecting data centers, digital infrastructure, large commercial and industrial energy users, or infrastructure development.

- Experience working with utility commissions, regional transmission organizations (RTOs), independent system operators (ISOs), legislative bodies, or trade associations.

- Demonstrated interest in energy infrastructure, grid modernization, reliability, decarbonization, and emerging energy technologies.

- Experience preparing policy submissions, regulatory comments, briefing documents, or stakeholder communications.

Education / Certifications:

- Bachelor's degree in Public Policy, Political Science, Law, Energy, Economics, Environmental Studies, Business, Engineering, or a related field required.

- Master's degree, Juris Doctor (JD), or other relevant advanced degree preferred.

title: Senior Energy & Land Development Associate
description:
The Senior Energy & Land Development Associate serves as a strategic partner to the Chief Development Officer and supports the execution of CyrusOne's growth and development objectives. The role works across Land Strategy, Power & Energy, Market Intelligence, Development Management, Investments, Finance, Legal, Operations, Sales, and Design & Construction to help drive alignment, support executive decision-making, and advance key strategic initiatives.

The Senior Associate plays a critical role in coordinating cross-functional efforts, analyzing business opportunities, developing executive-level materials, tracking organizational priorities, and supporting the execution of development projects and strategic initiatives. This position provides analytical, operational, and strategic support to the Development leadership team while helping ensure organizational priorities remain aligned with corporate growth objectives.

Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Executive Support

- Support the Chief Development Officer and Development leadership team in executing strategic priorities and growth initiatives.

- Prepare executive presentations, business cases, capital committee materials, board presentations, and other leadership communications.

- Conduct market, financial, operational, and strategic analyses to support executive decision-making.

- Assist with annual planning, budgeting, forecasting, and organizational goal-setting activities.

- Support the development and tracking of key performance indicators, strategic objectives, and departmental priorities.

- Research industry trends, competitive activity, and emerging opportunities relevant to the Development organization.

Development Portfolio Management

- Maintain visibility into development activities across Land Strategy, Power & Energy, Development Management, and Market Intelligence functions.

- Track project milestones, key decisions, risks, dependencies, and development timelines.

- Support development pipeline reporting and portfolio reviews.

- Develop dashboards, reports, and performance metrics to support leadership decision-making.

- Identify opportunities to improve project visibility, reporting accuracy, and organizational effectiveness.

Cross-Functional Project Coordination

- Coordinate activities among Development, Power & Energy, Land Strategy, Investments, Finance, Legal, Operations, Sales, and Design & Construction teams.

- Support strategic initiatives and special projects on behalf of Development leadership.

- Facilitate collaboration across stakeholders to ensure alignment and execution of organizational objectives.

- Track action items, decisions, and follow-up activities arising from leadership meetings and strategic reviews.

- Assist in identifying and resolving issues that may impact project execution or organizational priorities.

Market Intelligence & Business Analysis

- Support market research, competitive intelligence, and development opportunity assessments.

- Assist with evaluating potential development opportunities, including commercial, operational, power, infrastructure, and market-related considerations.

- Support preliminary financial analysis, underwriting activities, and business case development.

- Maintain relevant reporting, databases, and market intelligence resources.

- Analyze data and prepare recommendations to support strategic planning and investment decisions.

Organizational Effectiveness & Communications

- Assist in establishing and maintaining operating rhythms for the Development organization, including leadership meetings, business reviews, and strategic planning sessions.

- Develop executive communications, presentations, and organizational updates.

- Support process improvement initiatives and organizational effectiveness efforts.

- Help ensure leadership priorities, decisions, and objectives are effectively communicated and tracked throughout the organization.

- Support change management and implementation activities associated with key strategic initiatives.

Minimum Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Real Estate, Engineering, Energy Management, Project Management, or a related field.

- 3-7 years of experience in strategy, consulting, project management, infrastructure development, real estate development, finance, investments, energy, or related fields.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to synthesize complex information into actionable recommendations.

- Experience developing executive presentations, business cases, reporting packages, and strategic analyses.

- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and workstreams simultaneously.

- Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.

- Ability to build relationships and work effectively across multiple levels of an organization.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in data centers, digital infrastructure, commercial real estate, energy, utilities, construction, or development-related industries.

- Experience supporting executive leadership teams or strategic initiatives.

- Experience within a private equity-backed or high-growth environment.

- Financial modeling, underwriting, or investment analysis experience.

- MBA or other relevant advanced degree preferred.

Work Requirements

- Travel as required to support development activities, strategic initiatives, leadership meetings, and industry events.

title: Senior Manager, Real Estate Site Selection, Acquisition & Development
description:
We are seeking a Senior Manager, Real Estate Site Selection, Acquisition and Development to join our team! The Senior Manager will help develop the location strategy to determine where to pursue sites, run the end-to-end site selection process, negotiate land acquisition contracts, and conduct due diligence necessary to acquire sites and grow our Data Center portfolio, ultimately creating a pipeline of high-quality data center sites that are ready for construction.

In this role, you will work directly with land owners/investors, data center developers, local jurisdictions, land use attorneys and consultants to identify and successfully navigate the required real estate entitlements to acquire and develop new data center sites.

We are looking for someone who is ambitious and ready to help tackle challenges, with great verbal and written communication skills, technical comfort, superb organizational and project management capabilities, a strong strategic mindset, and the ability to work in a dynamic environment, often with limited direction. This individual must operate with the highest level of integrity while working with landowners, communities, and government officials, and support our commitment to responsible site selection, including the highest level of respect for the environment and the communities in which they operate.

What You Will Do:

- Lead land development efforts on new projects.

- Assess the entitlements process (rezonings, land use permitting, etc.), lead relationships with government officials, community stakeholders, etc., and work with colleagues and external consultants to complete entitlement work.

- Work with internal and external commercial and technical teams to identify, define, and pursue new site selection projects and initiatives that will help meet the data center industry’s growth needs.

- Build and lead teams of vendors and consultants to evaluate site feasibility.

- Assist in developing site plans that deliver the best in class product consistent with market conditions.

- Lead multiple complex contract negotiations.

- Manage engineering consultants to complete various stages of technical due diligence; understand the implications of the study results and be able to develop a commercial strategy, such as which risks can/should be mitigated, what are the appropriate action items to mitigate risks, and how much money should be spent to do so.

- Work cross-functionally with other internal and external teams, including Design Engineering, Legal, Tax, External Affairs, Policy and Regulatory, and Construction to inform the project and real estate strategy.

- Manage communications with a variety of project stakeholders (landowners, utility company representatives, economic development officers, government officials, vendors, consultants, legal counsel, internal subject matter experts and executives, customers, etc.).

- Understanding the technical requirements of our design engineering teams and developing solutions that meet the design and business objectives.

- Involvement in the full construction process to deliver all aspects of a project to include building, data center specific power, and all other site utilities.

- Facilitate strategy for required infrastructure improvements. Facilitate internal and external design and development partners for their functional area deliveries as related to Real Estate Site Selection, Acquisition and Development.

- Cultivate local government relationships and lead the entitlement process.

- Partner with developers and the local jurisdiction and participate in any local meetings and hearings relating to these projects.

- Preparation of transaction summaries to the senior management team regarding progress, financial approvals and overall deal costs / benefits.

- Develop project summaries and strategy presentations for internal teams and customers.

- Support the development of processes, standards, and tools to implement a repeatable process for site selection, acquisitions, and contracting.

What We Are Looking For:
Required

- 5+ years of professional experience in site selection, project management, and/or the development of data centers, real estate, or other large infrastructure or capital projects.

- 5+ years experience developing, negotiating and executing business agreements.

- Bachelor's Degree.

- Experience managing relationships and representing business interests with governments, utilities, potential suppliers, and other stakeholders.

- Comfort communicating commercial, market, and contractual details to management.

- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules.

- Ability to work independently, think creatively, and deliver results with limited direction.

- Strong negotiation skills.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Strong organizational and project management skills.

- High attention to detail.

- Proficient in MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint. Salesforce is a plus.

- Travel required.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in negotiating complex agreements with an understanding of legal terminology and reasoning.

- Experience interpreting technical or engineering data and making business recommendations.

Why Join Us?:

- Be part of the rapidly growing   data   center   industry powering the world’s digital infrastructure.

- Collaborative environment focused on commitment, accountability, respect and excellence.

- Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plans, life and disability insurance, access to mental health resources and employee assistance program.

- Competitive pay, performance bonus, 401(k) retirement plan with company match.

- Generous paid time off and holidays.

title: Senior Market Intelligence Analyst
description:
We are seeking a Senior Market Intelligence Analyst to join our Land and Power Strategy team. The successful candidate will be responsible for supporting strategic, data-driven insights on global data center markets to support business planning, market entry, expansion strategy, and executive decision-making. This role analyzes market fundamentals across supply, demand, pricing, competitive activity, land, power, and infrastructure readiness, translating complex data into clear business implications.
The role requires deep familiarity with the data center industry, strong analytical rigor, and the ability to work across a wide range of internal and external datasets. The Senior Market Intelligence Analyst will also contribute as an informal leader within the team by mentoring junior colleagues, improving workflows, and helping elevate overall analytical capabilities. This work is global in scope and supports decision-making across multiple regions and markets.

What You Will Do:

- Lead research and analysis of global data center, cloud, and digital infrastructure trends, including demand drivers, pricing, supply and demand dynamics, and hyperscaler infrastructure rollouts.

- Analyze market fundamentals across global metros to identify strategic risks and opportunities related to customer demand, competitive supply, land availability, utility and power conditions, and regulatory dynamics.

- Support data-driven recommendations to support market entry, expansion, and market prioritization strategies across global regions.

- Track developments across AI, cloud, digital infrastructure, energy, and real estate, and translate them into actionable implications for site selection and location planning.

- Own and enhance global market intelligence frameworks using demand signals, infrastructure readiness, power availability, policy considerations, and commercial attractiveness.

- Build, maintain, and continuously improve structured global market datasets, including pricing, supply pipelines, vacancy, land, power availability, and other key strategic inputs.

- Own the integrity, structure, governance, and version control of internal market intelligence databases and analytical workflows.

- Develop dashboards, visualizations, presentations, and executive-ready outputs in Excel, PowerPoint, and BI tools to support decision-making at senior leadership and board levels.

- Leverage third-party data platforms and providers supporting data center, energy and power, land, and real estate analysis to strengthen market intelligence and strategic recommendations.

- Provide informal leadership and mentorship to junior team members through guidance, knowledge sharing, review of work product, and support for best practices in analysis and reporting.

What We Are Looking For:
Required

- 5–10 years of experience in market intelligence, strategy, consulting, investment analysis, or data analysis, with direct data center industry experience required.

- Strong understanding of global data center market dynamics, including supply, demand, pricing, hyperscaler activity, infrastructure constraints, and site selection considerations.

- Experience using third-party data providers and software platforms that support data center, energy and power, land, and real estate comparable analysis.

- Strong proficiency in Excel and experience working with large, structured datasets and building repeatable analytical models.

- Experience using data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau to present insights clearly and effectively.

- Familiarity with mapping software such as QGIS, Mapbox, or ArcGIS, and comfort working with spatial data, is preferred.

- High attention to detail, strong intellectual curiosity, and the ability to investigate trends, anomalies, and emerging opportunities.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex analysis into clear, decision-oriented insights for a variety of audiences.

- Proactive, organized, and able to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment with a high degree of visibility, responsibility and independence.

- Demonstrated ability to provide informal leadership, collaborate cross-functionally, and mentor others in a dynamic team environment.

- Must be able to travel up to 10%, depending on business needs.

Preferred

- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Data Analytics, Economics, Statistics, Geography, Real Estate, or a related field.

- Advanced degree (Master’s/MBA) or relevant professional certifications such as CFA, PMP, or Data Analytics certifications are a plus, but not required.
